english.note: Use this when merely limits or softens an action, opinion, or situation rather than stressing strict numerical exclusivity.
Use this when “literally” means merely or just, especially to downplay how simple an action is.

examples.english: I was merely asking; you don't have to get so angry.
examples.traditional: 我只係問吓啫，你唔使咁嬲。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1 nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 nau1

examples.english: I literally just asked, that’s all.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1
